newsitem.title: LIECHTENSTEIN: SOCCER-LIECHTENSTEIN WITHOUT FRICK FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIECHTENSTEIN WITHOUT FRICK FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Mario Frick, Liechtenstein's only professional player, was not among the 18 nominated by coach Alfred Riedl on Friday for a World Cup group eight qualifier against Lithuania next Wednesday.
Riedl, who will be making his home coaching debut for Liechtenstein, was forced to rule out Frick, a midfielder with Swiss first division club Basle, because of injury.
Also missing will be striker Harry Zech, who scored for Liechtenstein in their 2-1 loss to Lithuania in Vilnius.
The game will be the first at home for the part-timers from Liechtenstein since they suffered one of the worse defeats in World Cup history, an 11-1 loss to Macedonia last November.
"It's going to be very tough," said Riedl. "Really there aren't a lot of chances for us."
Liechtenstein have not won in five World Cup qualifiers and have been outscored 29-3.
Goalkeepers - Martin Oehry (SV Frastanz), Martin Heeb (Vaduz).

Defenders - Thomas Hanselmann (Balzers), Patrick Hefti (Vaduz), Patrik Marxer (USV), Juegen Ospelt (USV), Martin Stocklasa (USV), Daniel Telser (Balzers), Ralf Oehri (Rapperswil), Thomas Verling (USV).
Midfielders - Ralf Ackermann (Schaan), Christoph Frick (Balzers), Daniel Hasler (Vaduz), Peter Klaunzer (USV), Alexander Schaedler (USV), Martin Telser (Balzers).
